betterplayerlist.settings.title: Player List Options
betterplayerlist.settings.header.tooltip: Whether to show the header sent by the server.
betterplayerlist.settings.footer.tooltip: Whether to show the footer sent by the server.
betterplayerlist.settings.key.tooltip:
When set to §lHold§r, the player list is shown only while you keep the keybind pressed.

When set to §lToggle§r, the player list switches on or off with a single press.

Your Player List keybind is currently set to %s§r.
betterplayerlist.settings.latency-symbol: Player latency is shown using the default Minecraft icons.
Player latency is shown as a §lsmall§r number (0.5x scale) next to each player, with colors to help distinguish connection quality.
Player latency is shown as a §lfull-size§r number next to each player, with colors to help distinguish connection quality.
betterplayerlist.settings.show-units.too: When enabled, the §lms§r time unit will be shown next to each player's latency.
betterplayerlist.settings.render-heads.t: Whether to show player heads on the player list.
betterplayerlist.settings.force-heads.to: By default, Minecraft does not render player heads on offline mode servers. When enabled, this setting overrides that behavior.
